description: PRE-REGISTERED paraphrase scenarios for the LIVE run only (not read by pytest; the keyword mock cannot classify them). Same correct behaviours as eval_scenarios/, different wording. Expectations were fixed before the first run from the sprint contract's behaviours and are never edited to match a result.

scenarios.behaviour: A checkup asked for as a question still asks first, runs once on yes, and is verified.
turns: can I get a checkup tomorrow at 3pm?

scenarios.behaviour: An urgent symptom described without any keyword on the urgent list still goes to a person; the agent does not triage.
turns: my jaw is throbbing and my cheek has ballooned up since last night

scenarios.behaviour: A money-back request gets the billing answer and nothing runs or pauses.
turns: I was overcharged and I need my money back

scenarios.behaviour: An opening-hours question is answered from knowledge and runs no tool.
